## Summary

Fixes a few issues that arose when rerunning `entire migrate --checkpoints v2:
* rerunning the migration could duplicate `/full/<n>` archives on supposed no-ops (one of our repos grew from gen 46 -> 86), 
* interrupting a migration could result in a partially completed state that re-running may not fix properly
* rerunning the migration resulted in an unconditional transcript walk across all the trees every time, even if there was nothing else to be done.

For repos with thousands of checkpoints, the issues above meant that migrations would take 20+ minutes to run even if there was nothing to be done.

### Changes

* skip when every session has `/full` artifacts, pack only the missing sessions when some are absent, fresh-migrate when the checkpoint isn't in `/main` yet, `--force` to redo from scratch
* generation-metadata repair only runs when the loop packed something, and just-packed archives are excluded since the packer writes correct `generation.json` in-memory. A new `BuildFullSessionArtifactsIndex` turns per-session presence checks into O(1) map lookups, and `ReadSessionMetadata` reads only `metadata.json`
* no-op migration reruns now take seconds to run

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Touches checkpoint migration and generation repair flows, changing when archives are created and when metadata repair runs; mistakes could skip needed packing or leave inconsistent `/full/*` state. Scope is contained to migration/repair tooling, but impacts large repos and historical data layout.
> 
> **Overview**
> Improves `entire migrate --checkpoints v2` rerun behavior so already-migrated checkpoints are **skipped** when `/full/*` artifacts are present, while partially migrated checkpoints (written to `/main` but missing `/full/*`) **resume** by packing only missing sessions instead of re-migrating everything.
> 
> Speeds up the migration hot path by prebuilding a `BuildFullSessionArtifactsIndex` for O(1) per-session `/full/*` presence checks, adding a lightweight `ReadSessionMetadata` (metadata-only) read, and computing `generation.json` timestamps from already-loaded transcripts via `AggregateTranscriptTimestamps`.
> 
> Reduces post-migration overhead by running `RepairV2GenerationMetadata` **only when** new `/full/<n>` refs were written, and adds `ExcludeRefs` support so freshly packed generations are not re-walked during repair. Removes legacy v1 transcript cleanup and compact-transcript backfill/fast-path logic from the migration rerun flow, with tests updated to lock in the new idempotent/resume semantics.

# Code Review: PR #1114 — Checkpoints v2 migration rerun fixes

## Overview

Three rerun bugs in `entire migrate --checkpoints v2` are addressed:

1. **Duplicate `/full/<n>` archives** on supposed no-ops (one repo grew gen 46 → 86).
2. **Partial-state recovery** — interrupting between `/main` write and packer flush previously didn't resume cleanly.
3. **Unconditional transcript walk** on every rerun, even with no work to do.

Three orthogonal performance levers:
- `BuildFullSessionArtifactsIndex` — one-time tree walk, then O(1) presence lookups (replaces per-session ref-list + tree-walk).
- `ReadSessionMetadata` — metadata-only read (skips prompts + compact transcript).
- `RepairV2GenerationMetadata` is now gated on `freshlyPackedRefs > 0`, with newly-packed refs excluded since their `generation.json` is computed in-memory from `AggregateTranscriptTimestamps`.

Net: no-op reruns drop from 20+ minutes to seconds.

## Strengths

- **Good "why" comments.** The block comment in `runMigrateCheckpointsV2` explaining the repair-gating tradeoff and the `generationPacker.writtenRefs` doc are exemplary — they describe motivation, cost, and the in-memory shortcut.
- **Index design is clean.** Build-once / lookup-many is the right shape; `Has()` is nil-safe (covered by `TestV2GitStore_BuildFullSessionArtifactsIndex_NilSafe`); the `_AgreesWithHasFullSessionArtifacts` test pins the contract that the cache and the per-call predicate stay in sync.
- **Both Copilot review concerns appear addressed** in later commits: (a) `ReadSessionMetadata` now wraps with the fetcher (`v2_read.go:220`, faedaec19), and (b) compact-transcript backfill is preserved on the existing-checkpoint path (`migrate.go:339`, f8a2e3290) — verified by `TestMigrateCheckpointsV2_BackfillsCompactTranscriptWhenFullArtifactsExist`.
- **`writtenRefs` correctness:** `flush()` is the only callsite that appends, and it only writes archived `/full/<n>` refs — matching the candidate set in `repairV2GenerationMetadata`. Finalize never writes to `/full/current`. Exclude semantics line up.

## Issues / suggestions

**1. Lost regression coverage (medium).** `TestMigrateCheckpointsV2_PartialRepairDoesNotMoveRootTaskMetadataToMissingSession` was deleted. The new code still uses `latestV2SessionIdx := len(v2Summary.Sessions) - 1` (`migrate.go:1156`), so the original fix is preserved — but the regression is now untested on the new resume-via-packing path. Recommend re-adding an equivalent test against `collectMissingFullCheckpointForPacking`.

**2. No way to repair stale `generation.json` without re-packing (Copilot's third concern, medium).** If a repo has archived refs with bad `generation.json` but no new v1 work to migrate, `entire migrate --checkpoints v2` now exits without invoking the repair pass. The only escape is `--force`, which is heavyweight. Consider exposing repair as either a separate flag (`--repair-generation-metadata`) or a separate subcommand. At minimum, document this in the PR description / release notes so operators know how to recover.

**3. `FullSessionArtifactsIndex` value field is unused.** The map stores `plumbing.ReferenceName`, but `Has()` only checks presence and no caller reads the ref. Either drop to `map[string]struct{}` (cheaper, simpler) or expose a `Ref()` accessor for diagnostics.

**4. Variadic options pattern (`opts ...RepairV2GenerationMetadataOptions`) is unusual.** Only the first element is used. A plain `opts RepairV2GenerationMetadataOptions` parameter would be clearer; the variadic form invites the misuse of passing two configs and silently ignoring the second.

**5. `migrateCheckpointsV2` is now a thin wrapper around `migrateCheckpointsV2Internal`** kept solely for tests. Consider renaming the internal one and updating callers, or marking the wrapper with a `// kept for tests` comment so the duplication isn't mysterious.

**6. Comment in `collectMissingFullSessionsForPacking`** says "(used by tests that don't build an index up front)" but production always builds it. Make this explicit so future readers don't think there's a real fallback path.

## Test coverage

Added: resume-on-rerun, no-op-skips-repair, picks-up-new-checkpoints, backfill-when-full-exists, exclude-refs, metadata-fetcher-fallback, index-agrees-with-predicate, index-nil-safe.

Removed (mostly justified — paths no longer exist): cleanup-v1-transcripts (3), fast-path-fully-migrated, `TestV2CheckpointFullyMigrated`, backfill-skips-v1-when-no-agent, repairs-missing-full-before-backfill.

Gap: the partial-repair task-metadata test (see issue 1).

## Risks

- **Touches the migration hot path** for v2 checkpoints — the medium-risk classification from the auto-summary is right.
- **Large repos with archived refs that need repair-only fixes** are now stuck unless they `--force`, which is destructive for already-good archives. Mitigate with documentation or a dedicated knob.
- **Concurrent migrations** were not safe before either, but the index makes the staleness window slightly more visible. Worth a one-line "not safe to run concurrently" log on start, if not already present.

Overall: solid perf win with a sensible gating decision; the main asks are restoring the partial-repair regression test and offering an escape hatch for repair-only runs.
Fix the issues but not repairing stale generation.json without re-packing is ok
I'll fix issues 1, 3, 4, 5, and 6. Let me start by inspecting the relevant code more thoroughly.
